svg.title: Assured Arc architecture
svg.desc: An original field-notebook style architecture drawing. A developer objective enters through VS Code or GitHub Copilot CLI, becomes an acceptance contract, routes through up to three skills, and enters a bounded seven-phase orchestrator loop. The orchestrator delegates to five isolated workers with one writer and independent verification. Optional Obsidian context, three reviewed research MCP servers, exact tool policy hooks, metadata-only traces, installer state, rollback, and human review support a verified result.

g.text: one intent · two native hosts · one bounded evidence loop

path.data-motion-intent: causality: developer objective becomes acceptance contract
verification: independent verifier gates the outcome

path.data-motion-intent: progress: selected context enters the bounded loop
